gloss: without looking aside; single-mindedly; with total focus

definitions.gloss: without looking aside; single-mindedly; with total focus; without distraction
definitions.explanation: Doing something with complete concentration, without being distracted by anything else. Literally 'without even glancing to the side.' Always used in a positive sense, praising dedication and focus.

examples.japanese: {脇目|わきめ}も{振|ふ}らず⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
{脇目|わきめ}も{振|ふ}らず⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}んだ→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧。
examples.english: I devoted myself to studying single-mindedly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脇目|わきめ}も{振|ふ}らず⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}して→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧、⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She focused on her work single-mindedly and was promoted to department head in three years.

notes: {脇目|わきめ} means 'a sideways glance' and ⟦{振|ふ}ら→振る：01983_furu⟧ず is the negative form of ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to turn). The expression is always used in the fixed negative form — you cannot say {脇目|わきめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧. Functions as an adverb modifying the following verb. Commonly paired with: ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run), ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work), ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧ (to study), ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to advance). Conveys admiration for intense dedication.
